tweet.text:
new in Dr Eggbot (v0.2.0):

• eggbot can do a health check on all your routines for unused or expensive ones. it will ask if you want to do one when you first add dr eggbot, and you can also ask it to do it regularly as a routine! defaults to weekly
• eggbot also now comes with a daily (customizable) routine to skim recent chats across your bots for friction (corrections, misunderstandings, “not what i meant”), then suggests skills, bots, or routines to continuously improve your grok @bot setup!

to update you will need to reinstall dr eggbot. if you have anything you want to carry over, ask the new bot to copy over anything relevant, and then you can delete the old one

https://x.ai/bot/93gOz3op1UQdBdbekQFLK
